introHtml: Waterproof lunch bags, boxes, and totes keep contents dry and protected, whether for outdoor crews, beach events, or daily commutes. Unlike standard insulated bags, waterproof options feature sealed seams and water-resistant exteriors that prevent leaks from melted ice or rain. Choose from backpack coolers like the 24-Can Elite Backpack Cooler or classic totes like the 12-Can Lakeside Cooler, all customizable with your logo via screen printing or embroidery. Perfect for trade shows, corporate gifts, or employee appreciation programs.
